name: vizbee-sample-webapp
description: Cross-TV sample web app (VizioSmartCast / SamsungTizen / LGWebOS / Xbox) demonstrating clean platform abstraction, feature flags, and a stub-first Vizbee SDK integration seam.

scripts.build:tizen: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode tizen && bash scripts/build-tizen.sh
scripts.build:webos: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode webos && bash scripts/build-webos.sh
scripts.start:desktop: vite build --mode desktop && vite preview --outDir dist/desktop --host
scripts.start:vizio: vite build --mode viziosmartcast && vite preview --outDir dist/viziosmartcast --host
scripts.start:tizen: vite build --mode tizen && vite preview --outDir dist/tizen --host
scripts.start:webos: vite build --mode webos && vite preview --outDir dist/webos --host
scripts.start:xbox: vite build --mode xbox && vite preview --outDir dist/xbox --host
scripts.ship:tizen:script: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode tizen && npm run deploy:s3 tizen
scripts.ship:tizen:npm:es5: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/samsung vite build --mode tizen --outDir dist/tizen-with-nodemodule/es5 && npm run deploy:s3 tizen-with-nodemodule/es5
scripts.ship:tizen:npm:es6: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/samsung/es6 vite build --mode tizen --outDir dist/tizen-with-nodemodule/es6 && npm run deploy:s3 tizen-with-nodemodule/es6
scripts.ship:tizen:npm: npm run ship:tizen:npm:es5 && npm run ship:tizen:npm:es6
scripts.ship:webos:script: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode webos && npm run deploy:s3 webos
scripts.ship:webos:npm:es5: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/lg vite build --mode webos --outDir dist/webos-with-nodemodule/es5 && npm run deploy:s3 webos-with-nodemodule/es5
scripts.ship:webos:npm:es6: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/lg/es6 vite build --mode webos --outDir dist/webos-with-nodemodule/es6 && npm run deploy:s3 webos-with-nodemodule/es6
scripts.ship:webos:npm: npm run ship:webos:npm:es5 && npm run ship:webos:npm:es6
scripts.ship:xbox:script: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode xbox && npm run deploy:s3 xbox
scripts.ship:xbox:npm:es5: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/xbox vite build --mode xbox --outDir dist/xbox-with-nodemodule/es5 && npm run deploy:s3 xbox-with-nodemodule/es5
scripts.ship:xbox:npm:es6: tsc --noEmit && VIZBEE_SDK_NPM_PACKAGE=@vizbeetv/sdk/xbox/es6 vite build --mode xbox --outDir dist/xbox-with-nodemodule/es6 && npm run deploy:s3 xbox-with-nodemodule/es6
scripts.ship:xbox:npm: npm run ship:xbox:npm:es5 && npm run ship:xbox:npm:es6
scripts.ship: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode tizen && vite build --mode webos && vite build --mode xbox && npm run deploy:s3 tizen webos xbox
scripts.ship:all: npm run ship:tizen:script && npm run ship:tizen:npm && npm run ship:webos:script && npm run ship:webos:npm && npm run ship:xbox:script && npm run ship:xbox:npm
